Package com.signalwire.sdk.runtime

Enum Class ExecutionMode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ExecutionMode>
com.signalwire.sdk.runtime.ExecutionMode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ExecutionMode>, Constable
public enum ExecutionMode extends Enum<ExecutionMode>
Runtime deployment environments the SDK knows about.

Detected from well-known environment variables set by the hosting platform. Mirrors get_execution_mode() in the Python SDK and detectPlatform() in the TypeScript SDK.

Use detect() to read the actual process environment, or detect(EnvProvider) to pass a test double.

    • detect

      public static ExecutionMode detect(EnvProvider env)
      Detect the execution mode from the given EnvProvider.

      Detection order matches the Python reference: CGI, Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure Functions, then fall back to SERVER. Order matters because some environments set overlapping variables (e.g. a container running under API Gateway in "Lambda container mode").

      Parameters:
      env - environment variable source (injectable for tests).
      Returns:
      the detected mode.

    • getExecutionMode

      public static String getExecutionMode()
      Cross-language SDK contract: return the execution mode as the canonical lower-case-with-underscores string used by every port. Mirrors signalwire.core.logging_config.get_execution_mode in Python: one of "cgi", "lambda", "google_cloud_function", "azure_function", or "server".
      Returns:
      canonical mode string detected from the process environment

    • getExecutionMode

      public static String getExecutionMode(EnvProvider env)
      Same as getExecutionMode() but reads from the supplied EnvProvider, allowing tests to drive every branch deterministically.
      Parameters:
      env - environment variable source (injectable for tests).
      Returns:
      canonical mode string.

      public static boolean isServerlessMode()
      Cross-language SDK contract: true when the process is running inside any serverless / short-lived environment (i.e. anything other than "server"). Mirrors signalwire.utils.is_serverless_mode in Python.
      Returns:
      true unless the detected mode is "server".
